serialization.method: actual uncompressed NumPy NPZ payloads including all stored factors, biases and codes

notes: Development seeds were 13 and 29; fresh seeds were fixed in PROTOCOL before fresh evaluation.
Teacher family is a synthetic binary linear classifier orbit and is intentionally favorable to a 2D rotation View.
Unaligned random task separators are a registered scope/stress condition.
BatchEnsemble rank-one factors were applied to a one-layer single-output classifier; this is not a standard deep-network BatchEnsemble reproduction.
No neural network, GPU throughput, or general ensemble capacity claim is established.
